title: Trump told of hybrids living among us during his briefing

tellings.quote: Trump was during that briefing he was told that there are hybrids and told the narrative that they were that there's hybrids that potentially live amongst us and and that Trump's response was, "You mean like Adam Schiff?"

plain: During a briefing on the alien question, Donald Trump was reportedly told that there are human-alien hybrids that "potentially live amongst us," and he answered, "You mean like Adam Schiff?" Congressman Eric Burlison tells Michels this as something he heard about the briefing, not something he saw. If true, it would mean a president was given that story as part of an official briefing.
